title: Coast Guard rescues 4 men from vessel grounding in Pelican Cay, St. Thomas, U.S. Virgin Islands
description: The crew of a Coast Guard Air Station Borinquen MH-60T Jayhawk helicopter hoisted four men from a pleasure craft, after the vessel ran aground on Pelican Cay in Saint Thomas, U.S. Virgin Islands Oct. 31, 2021.  Once removed from the vessel, the boaters where transported to the Cyril E. King airport in Saint Thomas, where awaiting Emergency Medical Service personnel rendered assistance. (U.S. Coast Guard video)
